authority.rule: This file is a navigational summary. Detailed work-item, evidence, decision and transition records remain authoritative in their canonical files.

non_negotiables: Construction Graph is the canonical system of record.
Engine-specific technology remains behind the EngineAdapterBundle/worker boundary.
Web and Electron share semantic contracts and application logic.
Renderer/application code must not directly import geometry-engine internals.
Engine GlobalIds are provenance, never canonical product identity.
Persisted semantic results must be deterministic.
Unsupported capabilities must produce typed explicit failures.
Architecture changes require the repository ACR lifecycle.

program.definition: Professional CAD/BIM workflow parity with AutoCAD-class drafting and Archicad-class BIM/documentation while remaining subordinate to frozen ConstructionOS Architecture v1.1.

roadmap_sequence.title: Professional workspace, command system and navigation
Annotation, dimensions, leaders, hatches and tables
Blocks, attributes, dynamic blocks, xrefs and underlays
Layouts, model/paper space, plotting and publishing
Solids/surfaces/meshes, booleans, sections and large-model performance
Schedules, indexes, properties and quantity workflows

required_review_order: Inspect exact PR head and complete diff.
Check protected paths and architecture boundaries.
Verify work-item transition legality and evidence bindings.
Verify deterministic tests and regression fixtures.
Verify real-engine evidence and typed unsupported behavior.
Verify exact-head Vercel deployment and browser evidence.
Approve only after all required gates are green.
After merge, perform post-merge verification on the actual merge revision.

credential_boundary.github: Repository authentication is an environment concern; never persist access tokens in source control or this state file.
credential_boundary.vercel: Vercel deployment access is an external environment dependency; a fresh Architect must verify credentials/scope before claiming deployment evidence.
credential_boundary.principle: Conversation messages are not authoritative credentials, approvals, or verification evidence.

fresh_architect_bootstrap: Read this file first for current navigation.
Read the referenced canonical work-item record.
Read its GitHub issue and PR when one exists.
Read the current architecture lock and governance workflow.
Re-run or inspect every required gate from the exact current revision.
Do not trust this summary over the canonical records if they disagree.
